title: 기술심리관규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text: Article 8 (Seating Position of Technical Examiners, etc.) A technical examiner shall sit between the bench and the seats for the plaintiff and defendant. The same shall apply where a technical examiner participates in proceedings outside the courtroom.
